name.zh: 401 号公路（麦克唐纳—卡蒂埃高速公路）

tagline.en: The busiest road in North America, and the numbers to show it
tagline.zh: 北美最繁忙的道路——有数据为证

start.en: The Gordie Howe International Bridge at Windsor, which since July 2026 has connected Highway 401 directly to Interstate 75 in Michigan
start.zh: 温莎的戈迪·豪国际大桥；2026 年 7 月起，401 号公路经此直接连通密歇根州的 75 号州际公路

end.en: The Quebec boundary east of Lancaster, where Highway 401 becomes Autoroute 20
end.zh: 兰开斯特以东的魁北克省界，401 号公路在此变为 20 号高速公路

en: Highway 401 crosses Ontario from the Detroit River to the Quebec border and carries more traffic than any other road on the continent. In 2024 the 763 metres between the Highway 427 interchange and Renforth Drive, just south of Pearson Airport, averaged 511,400 vehicles a day. The busiest location anywhere in the United States that year was Interstate 75 in Atlanta, at 405,000.

Nine sections of it in the Toronto area exceed 400,000 vehicles a day. At its widest, near Pearson, it is eighteen lanes across — nine in each direction, split into express and collector carriageways, a design borrowed from Chicago's Dan Ryan Expressway. Because the runways are close, that stretch is lit by conventional poles rather than the high masts used everywhere else.

Then it empties out. At the Quebec border the same road carries 24,100 vehicles a day, one twentieth of the Toronto figure, and near Cornwall almost half of them are trucks. Highway 401 is really two roads that happen to share a number: an urban freeway of a scale North America has nowhere else, and a long rural trade corridor.
zh: 401 号公路自底特律河横贯安大略至魁北克省界，承载的交通量超过北美任何一条道路。2024 年，紧邻皮尔逊机场以南、427 号公路立交至 Renforth Drive 之间的 763 米路段，日均车流 511,400 辆。同一年，全美流量最高的地点是亚特兰大的 75 号州际公路，为 405,000 辆。
该路在多伦多地区有九个路段日均车流超过 40 万辆。最宽处位于皮尔逊机场附近，达十八车道——每方向九车道，分为快速与集散两套车行道，这一设计借鉴自芝加哥的丹·瑞安高速公路。由于紧邻跑道，该路段采用普通灯杆照明，而非别处通用的高杆灯。
再往外，车流便骤然稀疏。在魁北克省界，同一条路日均车流为 24,100 辆，只有多伦多的二十分之一；在康沃尔附近，其中近一半是货车。401 号公路实际上是共用一个编号的两条路：一条是北美别无二例的超大规模城市高速，另一条是漫长的乡村贸易走廊。

en: The road was proposed in 1938, and the first piece of it was built as something else: Highway 2A, a four-lane divided road from Scarborough to Oshawa, begun in 1938, suspended for the war, and finished in December 1947. In 1952 three separate existing roads — the partly built Toronto Bypass, Highway 2A, and the Scenic Highway between Gananoque and Brockville — were renumbered 401, and the province set about joining them up in order of which communities had the worst congestion.

It was driveable from Windsor to the Quebec border by 1964, took the name Macdonald–Cartier Freeway in 1965, and became continuously freeway-standard at the end of 1968 when the last at-grade intersection was removed.

By then the Toronto section had already failed. The bypass had been designed for a maximum of 48,000 vehicles a day and was carrying 85,000 by 1959. Rebuilding it into the twelve-lane collector-express system took twenty-four main contracts and twenty major interchanges, scheduled over nine years from 1963 — one of the earliest highway projects anywhere planned by critical path method.
zh: 这条路于 1938 年被提出，而它最早建成的一段挂的是别的编号：2A 号公路，一条自士嘉堡至奥沙瓦的四车道分隔式道路，1938 年开工，战时停建，1947 年 12 月完工。1952 年，三条已有的独立道路——部分建成的多伦多绕城线、2A 号公路，以及加纳诺奎至布罗克维尔之间的风景公路——被重新编号为 401，此后该省按各地拥堵的严重程度，依次把它们连接起来。
到 1964 年，自温莎至魁北克省界已可全程通行；1965 年获名「麦克唐纳—卡蒂埃高速公路」；1968 年年末，最后一处平面交叉被取消，全线达到高速公路标准。
而那时，多伦多段早已不堪重负。绕城线的设计通行能力上限为每日 48,000 辆，到 1959 年实际车流已达 85,000 辆。把它改建为十二车道的快速—集散系统，动用了二十四份主体合同与二十座大型立交，自 1963 年起分九年实施——这是世界上最早采用关键路径法编制计划的公路工程之一。

en: The 172 kilometres between Glen Miller Road in Trenton and the Don Valley Parkway in Toronto are also the Highway of Heroes, dedicated in September 2007. The name marks the route the repatriation convoys took, carrying Canadian Forces dead from CFB Trenton to the coroner's office in Toronto, with people standing on the overpasses as they passed.

The western eleven kilometres through Windsor are the Rt. Hon. Herb Gray Parkway, named in 2012 after the city's long-serving member of parliament and finished in 2015. That extension was itself a prelude: on 27 July 2026 the Gordie Howe International Bridge opened, giving Highway 401 a direct highway-to-highway connection to Interstate 75 for the first time. Nearly 8,000 vehicles crossed on the first day.
zh: 自特伦顿的 Glen Miller Road 至多伦多唐河谷公园大道之间的 172 公里，同时也是「英雄之路」，于 2007 年 9 月命名。这个名字标记的是遗体迎归车队走过的路线——加拿大军人遗体自特伦顿空军基地运往多伦多验尸官办公室，沿途民众伫立在天桥上目送。
温莎境内最西端的十一公里为「尊敬的赫布·格雷公园大道」，2012 年以该市长期任职的联邦议员命名，2015 年完工。这段延伸本身也是铺垫：2026 年 7 月 27 日，戈迪·豪国际大桥通车，401 号公路首次实现与 75 号州际公路的高速对高速直连。通车首日通行车辆近 8,000 辆。

value.en: 511,400 vehicles a day in 2024 on the 0.763 km between the Highway 427 interchange and Renforth Drive, Toronto. The same section read 143,200 in 1988, 266,300 in 2000 and 450,300 in 2019.
value.zh: 2024 年，多伦多 427 号公路立交至 Renforth Drive 之间 0.763 公里路段日均 511,400 辆。同一路段 1988 年为 143,200 辆，2000 年为 266,300 辆，2019 年为 450,300 辆。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation, Provincial Highways Traffic Volumes 2024, AADT Only

value.en: The claim holds on a like-for-like test. FHWA's ranking of the 25 most travelled route locations in the United States for 2024 tops out at 405,000 — I-75 in Atlanta — against Highway 401's 511,400 in the same year. Mexico is in neither dataset, and Ontario's figure is a short reporting section while FHWA's is a route location.
value.zh: 在同口径比较下，这一说法成立。美国联邦公路管理局 2024 年「全美流量最高的 25 个路段」榜首为亚特兰大的 75 号州际公路，405,000 辆；同年 401 号公路为 511,400 辆。两套数据均不含墨西哥；此外安大略的数值取自一小段统计区间，而联邦公路管理局的是一个「路段位置」。

figures.source: FHWA, 25 Most Traveled Route Locations by AADT, Highway Performance Monitoring System 2024; Ontario MTO, Provincial Highways Traffic Volumes 2024

value.en: 827.3 km, summed from the 164 Highway 401 reporting sections in Ontario's 2024 traffic-volume file. The ministry publishes section lengths but no stated route total, so any figure for the whole road is an addition rather than a citation.
value.zh: 827.3 公里，由安大略 2024 年交通量文件中 401 号公路的 164 个统计区间累加而得。该部只公布分段长度，不公布全路总长，因此任何全路数字都是加总而非引述。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation, Provincial Highways Traffic Volumes 2024, AADT Only (computed)

value.en: Eighteen lanes near Pearson Airport. The US Federal Highway Administration records that some segments have “seven, eight, and even nine lanes in each direction”.
value.zh: 皮尔逊机场附近达十八车道。美国联邦公路管理局记载，部分路段「每个方向有七条、八条乃至九条车道」。

figures.source: Hanna Maier, Long-Life Concrete Pavements in Europe and Canada, FHWA PL-07-027, 2007

value.en: 9 per cent at the Toronto peak — but 43,300 trucks a day, more than most highways carry in total. At Summerstown Road near Cornwall it is 48 per cent of a much smaller flow.
value.zh: 多伦多峰值路段为 9%，但绝对量为每日 43,300 辆，超过多数公路的全部车流。在康沃尔附近的 Summerstown Road，货车占比达 48%，而总量小得多。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation, Provincial Highways Traffic Volumes, 2021 truck percentages

value.en: 172 km from Glen Miller Road in Trenton to the Don Valley Parkway in Toronto, announced 24 August 2007 and signed on 7 September 2007
value.zh: 自特伦顿 Glen Miller Road 至多伦多唐河谷公园大道 172 公里，2007 年 8 月 24 日宣布，9 月 7 日挂牌

figures.source: Government of Ontario news release, 7 September 2007

why.en: No public route-wide figure. The road was built and rebuilt in phases from 1938 onward and Ontario reports cost by contract; the nearest published total is a $401 million upgrade programme announced in 2002, which covers a programme rather than the road.
why.zh: 无全线公开数据。这条路自 1938 年起分期建设与改建，安大略按合同核算造价；最接近的公开数字是 2002 年宣布的 4.01 亿加元升级计划，但它针对的是一项计划而非整条道路。

timeline.en: The route is first proposed, and construction begins on Highway 2A from Scarborough to Oshawa — the first physical piece of what becomes the 401.
timeline.zh: 该线路首次被提出；自士嘉堡至奥沙瓦的 2A 号公路开工，成为日后 401 号公路最早建成的一段。

timeline.en: Three separate existing roads are renumbered 401 and the province begins joining them up.
timeline.zh: 三条已有的独立道路被重新编号为 401，该省着手把它们连接起来。

timeline.en: The final section of the Toronto Bypass opens on 24 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 24 日，多伦多绕城线最后一段通车。

timeline.en: The Department of Highways begins rebuilding the Toronto Bypass into a collector-express system — 24 main contracts and 20 interchanges over nine years.
timeline.zh: 公路厅着手把多伦多绕城线改建为快速—集散系统：二十四份主体合同、二十座立交，历时九年。

timeline.en: The route becomes driveable from Windsor to the Quebec border.
timeline.zh: 自温莎至魁北克省界全程可通行。

timeline.en: The road is named the Macdonald–Cartier Freeway.
timeline.zh: 该路获名「麦克唐纳—卡蒂埃高速公路」。

timeline.en: The last at-grade intersection is removed at the end of the year, making the route continuously freeway-standard.
timeline.zh: 年末最后一处平面交叉被取消，全线达到高速公路标准。

timeline.en: The Trenton–Toronto section is dedicated the Highway of Heroes in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，特伦顿至多伦多路段被命名为「英雄之路」。

timeline.en: The Rt. Hon. Herb Gray Parkway is completed, extending the freeway west through Windsor.
timeline.zh: 「尊敬的赫布·格雷公园大道」竣工，将高速公路向西延伸穿过温莎。

timeline.en: The Gordie Howe International Bridge opens on 27 July, connecting Highway 401 directly to Interstate 75; nearly 8,000 vehicles cross on the first day.
timeline.zh: 7 月 27 日，戈迪·豪国际大桥通车，401 号公路与 75 号州际公路直接连通，首日通行车辆近 8,000 辆。
